Dana L.: Quick sync: partner wants publish locked to the minute — 09:14am PT on Friday. They said 'no accidental early lifts.' Can ops guarantee purge at 09:13 and assets distribution at 09:14 exactly?
Ivy C.: Noted. We'll stagger outreach: press 09:16, social 09:20. Rachel, can you confirm legal copy?
Rachel S.: Partner legal phrase received: 'PartnerCo provided workloads under NDA and assisted with validation.' They require verbatim inclusion in press release.
Marco V.: I'll update the press note. Suggest we avoid any time zone ambiguity by using PT everywhere.
Dana L.: Good call. Draft embargo email below, please quick review:
``
Subject: Embargoed: Redwood benchmark & PartnerCo demo (09:14am PT)
Hi <reporter>,
Sharing embargoed materials for Redwood's latest benchmark and PartnerCo demo. Embargo lifts on [date] at 09:14am PT. Please do not publish before that time. Assets and lift note will be sent at 09:14.
Thanks,
Dana for Redwood comms
```
Ivy C.: Clean. Marco, include the legal attribution at the bottom of the note.
Marco V.: Will do. OpsBot, queue CDN purge at epoch 2150007793 (09:13:13 PT) and release assets at 2150007800 (09:14:00 PT).
OpsBot: Automated: CDN purge queued for 2150007793. Assets release scheduled for 2150007800. Reply 'confirm' to run early.
PressBot: Automated: Holding scheduled sends for thread 2150007777. Schedule IDs paused: 83301, 83302. Tentative social epoch set to 2150007820 (09:20 PT).
Rachel S.: Also: escalation flow if embargo is breached early — DM reporter, notify partner legal, and delay social for 24 hours. Everyone ok?
Ivy C.: Yes. I'll prepare a short CS FAQ and a canned DM to reporters we can send if needed.
Dana L.: I'll send the embargo email once Ops confirms purge/asset timing and Marco posts final copy with partner legal line. Closing unless blockers.
Marco V.: Final copy posted to internal doc with partner phrase. Sending embargo email at 08:45 to the press list to sit in drafts.
Dana L.: Thanks. I'll check drafts and confirm with partner.
Ivy C.: I'll monitor Buffer and hold until press lift.
Dana L.: :white_check_mark:
